title: When the Terminal Falls Again
author: Sebastian Villalobos
blurb: Jonah Oyelaran, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
